name: Korean Patch
description: Translates Geometry Dash into Korean, drawn in an outlined bitmap font that matches the game.

enabled.name: Korean text
enabled.description: Replaces game text with its Korean translation wherever one exists.

own-font.name: Use the bundled font
own-font.description: Draws Korean text in the bundled outlined font. Turn this off if a texture pack already gives the game a font that can draw Korean, so the two do not mix on one screen.

font.name: Font
font.description: Jua is the rounded font most Korean packs use. Dunggeunmo is a pixel font, which sits better with a pixel texture pack.

gemini-enabled.name: Ask Gemini for missing text
gemini-enabled.description: Text with no translation yet is sent to Gemini and the answer is kept in config/learned.json, which you can open and edit. It is a way of collecting candidates, not a finished translation: the mod cannot tell interface text from a level someone named, so check the file before trusting it.

gemini-key.name: Gemini API key
gemini-key.description: Your own key from Google AI Studio. It is stored in plain text on this device.

gemini-model.name: Gemini model
gemini-model.description: Change this if Google retires the model and requests start failing.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: Downloads the newest release straight from GitHub. Restart the game afterwards to apply it.
